name: logjam
title: logjam
blurb: the atproto firehose restaged as a freight yard. every commit is a shipment filed into a lane by its collection — post, like, repost, follow, block — rolling live from a DEPOT (the account's own PDS) to a HUB (the relay), with a running manifest ticker and throughput stats. deletes come back through the other way as recalls. @tynanpurdy.com's thread aside was "atproto for transportation logistics" — this is the protocol's own commit traffic playing freight, not real-world trucks.
